answer: A reviewer key is cheap if it needs no field time. Intake assigns one sounding shift on a published river delta: at dawn the applicant sets a numbered basalt bench-mark in a surveyed ridge notch, then walks that transect at hours 0, 6, and 12 while two hydrographers photograph the water line against the stone. Peers match the three frames to the official gauge file and the notch map. Cost is twelve hours plus one stone a second persona cannot reuse. A recycled serial, or frames more than 70 seconds off the posted clock, slash the bond 33 percent and freeze new soundings for eleven epochs.
